title: Under Frequency a phone gets DAWN's bottom bar back (Menu, Feed, Zap, Events, Marketplace), a drawer that opens on the member's standing, Ask Vera and the core features, and the mobile spacing, tap and overflow fixes from the 2026-10-14 audit

source.ref: Owner 2026-10-14: audit the mobile site on the new theme, bring back the bottom menu from the last mobile theme, clean up spacing and leftover hand-rolled CSS, make every core feature easy to reach, and give it some life.

detail: The Frequency member shell had no bottom bar on a phone: one burger, the Zap button hidden under 720px, and the right rail (streak, Zaps, Gems, Vera) gone below 680px. Now, under 768px (Tailwind md, the line every DAWN overlay clears the bar at): tab-bar.tsx draws DAWN's five slots from calmSpine() gate-filtered through canSee, as a floating frosted pill with the active tab in the section pill's gradient and Zap a raised breathing orb that rises the Zap sheet from the bar. Menu opens the drawer, which now leads with the streak, Zaps and Gems (the Vault's numbers), Keep learning, Ask Vera (open-vera) and eight toned core-feature tiles, plus Invite a friend (unreachable on a phone before). The kit's lane tokens (--tab-bar-h, --tab-bar-lift, --tab-bar-clearance) are restored below 768 so the toast lane, the Quest CTA and the Journey dock ride above the bar; the bar sits at z 46, under Mindless, Vera and dialogs, and steps aside on full-width editors, takeovers (isFullTakeover) and message threads. The rails now hide at 768 to match. Audit fixes: one mobile gutter, safe-area top for the installed app, 44px header and menu taps, the 721 to 767 drawer geometry, facet menus that no longer open off screen, a tap-a-day agenda on the phone calendar, event lanes and the Mindless orb that fit 320px, the DM pane on dvh, DAWN --color-*-bg tints replaced by Frequency colour-mixes, the undefined --fq-ease-in-out, and inline styles in the shell moved to classes. Then a design-system carry-over pass, six audits of design_handoff/frequency against the installed sheets (the generated kits drop nothing): the installer now installs colors.css's night UV and Thermal palettes (the website's data-time="night" bands had fallen to the day charge aura) and core.css is regenerated; inside a kit, headings and focus rings revert to the kit's layered rules (an unlayered globals.css rule had set every heading's leading and tracking and replaced every kit focus ring); the night room's aura and ink-on---pa text hold inside kit roots; reduced motion stops the aura and breath; DAWN cards nested in member bodies read as kit glass panels (hairline inside Settings panes); the templates' iridescent rings, glows, lifts and phone grids; header idle state, 40px header gutter, 360px notifications sheet, readable toast, tooltip frost; the tab bar on the kit's own idioms (no breathing halo, .97 press, the --pa dot); the signed-in website header fits 390px, the Home dock clears the closer, the phone menu sheet traps focus, safe areas; the admin console's section sub-pages reachable on a phone, the editor's Publish on screen at 390px. Deferred to keep this PR under the 40-file gate: kit buttons in the renewals table (MembershipPromoteButton, MembershipCancelButton) and tab stops on the admin tables other than Overview's.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const bar=r('components/frequency/members/shell/tab-bar.tsx'),hdr=r('components/frequency/members/shell/header.tsx'),css=r('app/themes/frequency/members-shell.css');const bad=[];if(!/calmSpine\(\)\.filter\(\(t\) => canSee/.test(bar))bad.push('the phone bar does not read the registry spine');if(!/<FqTabBar/.test(hdr))bad.push('the header does not mount the phone bar');if(!/max-width:767px\)\{[\s\S]*?--tab-bar-clearance:calc\(var\(--tab-bar-h\) \+ var\(--lane-rise\)\)/.test(css))bad.push('the lane tokens are not restored under 768, so overlays sit on the bar');if(!/fqm-tiles/.test(hdr)||!/open-vera/.test(hdr))bad.push('the phone drawer lost its core tiles or Ask Vera');if(bad.length){console.error('LIVE-923: '+bad.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
